Question: In Olive Garden, is the food cooked fresh or is the pasta and sauces boiled in a bag and then served? I just want to know how the food is prepared.
Answer: In Olive Garden, is the food cooked fresh or are the pasta and sauces boiled in a bag and then served? I worked for Olive Garden for more than a decade as a server and bartender, so I was often at the restaurant early and saw the cooks and the food prep of the early morning. While Olive Garden uses frozen items such as chicken, shrimp, and beef, the restaurant does make a good many of its dishes from scratch. The sauces and soups, for example, are prepped early in the morning. The cooks mix a canned sauce base with the correct amount of spices and vegetables and which are then cooked in large batches. The sauces are then portioned into gallon bags and rapidly cooled in an ice bath to slow bacteria growth. These bags are kept in the refrigerator until they need to be heated to the proper temperature in boiling water. The soups are done the same way. This process ensures that the sauces and soups always taste fresh and will not get someone sick. Pasta prep is similar. Pastas are cooked until they are close to al dente. They are then cooled in an ice bath and portioned into bags if they are a specialty pasta or put into chilled holding drawers for the cooks on the line to have easy access. As the tickets come into the kitchen, the cook can grab the correct pasta, put it into boiling water for 30–45 seconds, strain it, and plate it with the sauce. These methods allow the food to be fresh for the customer and helps the kitchen time the dishes so that they reach the table at the same time.

Question: Is the birth of Jesus on the 25th of December historically accurate or referenced in the Bible?
Answer: Is the birth of Jesus on the 25th of December historically accurate or referenced in the Bible? The short answer to this is that Jesus’ birth on December 25th is not accurate. The longer explanation for the choice of that date is slightly more complex. Many biblical scholars and experts have looked at the context of the books that account for the birth of Jesus and compared them with historical texts from the Roman Empire. The overall consensus is that He was likely born in March or April, not December. So why do we celebrate that date? The Roman Empire, like many other civilizations, had celebrations that centered around solstices and equinoxes, as well as fertility. One of the major celebrations of the winter was Saturnalia, which was the winter solstice that occurred every year around the 21st or 22nd of December, but due to the irregularities of the Julian calendar was celebrated on December 25. Early Christians were persecuted in the Empire, but Christianity eventually became the state religion of Rome. When this happened many of the festivals that Romans had celebrated were given over to Christianity, although Christians didn’t even celebrate Jesus’ birth for a little more than three centuries. Early Christians celebrated Epiphany in January, Pascha or Easter in March or April - was related to the Jewish Passover which changes yearly because the Jews use a lunar calendar, and Pentecost 50 days after Easter. It wasn’t until 336 A.D. that Constantine, who was the first Christian Roman emperor, celebrated the birth of Jesus in December. This celebration would later replace Saturnalia as an official holiday when he made Christianity the official religion of Rome. The other reason the Church decided on December was to complete the Christian calendar, which is the cycle of the life and ministry of Jesus. Christians are fond of symbolism and symbols and the early Church incorporated that symbolism in its calendar. For example, in the northern hemisphere, which is where these events occurred, December is the beginning of winter. Plants begin dying and wilting, fields and grazing lands are barren in the winter. This symbolizes the world’s status due to sin. Sin equals death. The world was in need of Christ to bring life back to it. Epiphany, which Jan 6, the day after the twelve days of Christmas, is the story of the Magi or Wise Men. Lent is usually in February and is the account of Jesus and his temptation in the wilderness and Jesus subsequent ministry. Pascha or Easter comes at the end of Lent and is the story of Jesus death and resurrection. Notice that Easter takes place in the spring. Life is everywhere during the spring. This symbolizes Jesus’s triumph over sin and death. The final celebration of Jesus’ ministry is Pentecost, which is the account of the disciples receiving the Holy Spirit. The rest of the calendar focuses on the Old Testament and the promise/prophecies of the coming of Jesus. These reasons for the December date of Jesus’ birth are no longer commonly known, but it’s importance is still felt in the church every Sunday.

Question: Do they actually cook the food at the Olive Garden?
Answer: Do they actually cook the food at Olive Garden? If by this question you mean to ask if the food is prepared by the cooks at the time of your order then the answer is mostly yes. The soups, sauces, appetizers, and many of the meals are prepared by hand and are made fresh daily. They follow strict guidelines to ensure freshness. The soups and sauces are prepared in large batches and then put into gallon bags and quickly cooled to below 40 degrees. They are then reheated as needed in boiling water to over 180 degrees. These procedures keep the food fresh and help prevent food borne illnesses. The appetizers are prepped to make them efficient and quick for the cooks. For example, the calamari is washed and measured into bags by weight. All the cook has to do is grab the correct portion, flour it, and fry it. The pasta is precooked in the morning and given an ice bath while it’s still al dente. It is then portioned into bags if it’s a specialty pasta or put into a large container if it’s something like spaghetti or fettuccine. When the dish is ordered, the cook puts the pasta into boiling water for a set time, strains it, and plates it with the measured ladle of sauce. Other entrees are cooked as they come in. A dish with chicken might need the chicken to be grilled or sautéed, which is done as each order comes in on the screen. Yes, Olive Garden does actually cook your food.

Question: Where does Olive Garden get their food?
Answer: Olive Garden gets most of their prepackaged food like pasta, canned tomatoes, and dry goods from warehouses that are owned and operated by Darden, Olive Garden’s parent company. Produce, bread, and perishables are brought by vendors who have contracted with Darden and use the recipes that are otherwise proprietary to the company. Olive Garden makes most of their sauces and all of their soups from scratch daily as well as prepping many of their salads, appetizers, and entrees by hand. The goal is to use as many fresh ingredients as possible while attempting to increase the speed of cooking to get food to the customer as quickly as possible.

Question: Why do you English speakers spell double 'o' while pronouncing a single one ('loose'), and vice versa ('lose')? I find it contradictive.
Answer: ‘Loose’ is pronounced with the oo sounding like a u with the s on the end; ‘lose’ has the oo sound with a z on the end. It is pronounced like looze. ‘Loose’ has a different meaning than ‘lose’ and a different pronunciation. Some examples: My pants are so loose they’re falling off of me! Your team will lose because we’re better! Often people get these confused when writing because autocorrect doesn’t catch the disparity between the meanings. I see examples of this often on posts in different social media forums.

Question: How did democracy take hold in England?
Answer: England doesn’t have a democracy, it has a constitutional monarchy. Until the 13th century England had been a monarchy and had emphasized the divine right of kings. Many monarchs abused this power, especially King John, the villain of the Robin Hood stories. After King Richard’s death, John returned and assumed the throne. Due to his abysmal failures in war and his negative treatment of his noblemen, and other factors, he faced a revolt by his barons and excommunication by the Pope. This was resolved by The Magna Carta or Great Charter which was signed by King John in 1215 A.D. King John was forced to sign this document as a peace treaty. It offered protections to the church and other institutions. Later monarchs made changes and continued to reissue the charter as it had become part of the political landscape. The Magna Carta also had the early principle of habeas corpus and greatly influenced the writing of the American Constitution. Over time other changes to the government would include the House of Lords and the House of Commons putting restrictions on the monarchy.

Question: Why would it be difficult to have a direct democracy?
Answer: A direct democracy would require a vote for every decision the government would have to make. The population would spend every moment voting on mundane day-to-day operations and every minor policy as well as larger issues. The average person could not be informed well enough to make these votes beneficial. America is a democratic republic where the population votes for representatives who then make the decisions and policy.

Question: Which phrase is grammatically correct, “it is she” or “it is her”?
Answer: The correct answer is: ‘it is she.’ This is due to the fact that ‘is’ is a being verb and therefore connects ‘she’ to ‘it.’ Since ‘it’ is nominative, ‘she’ must be the same as the subject of the sentence. An example of this would be: It is she who runs the government.

Question: What is the evidence that democracy can survive in the long term?
Answer: Pure democracy cannot exist long term, but forms of democracy endure today and have proven to be the most humane ways of governance when balanced. Democracy has been around for thousands of years. It was developed and implemented by the Greeks with varying levels of success. The reason pure democracy fails is that every decision requires a vote. As society grows and becomes more complex it cannot be sustained by voting. Another problem with democracy is that votes decide everything. For example, a majority vote could take away personal property or rights. Because of human nature democracy could never survive long term without being tempered with another form of government.

Question: What is the historical significance of the Annexation of Texas in 1845?
Answer: The addition of Texas to the US is historically significant because it is the only state to join the Union by treaty. This treaty has provisions in it that give the state of Texas some interesting concessions. For example, the state has equal authority with the federal government over the gulf out to the twelve mile mark, which is where International waters begin. Texas also has the right to divide itself into as many as five smaller states, which no other state has. Its annexation is also significant because it and California were the only two countries to join the US.
